data.desc: Buda Juice (NYSE American: BUDA | NYSE Texas: BUDA) is the creator and pioneer of the Ultra Fresh category, delivering freshly crafted citrus juices, lemonades, wellness shots and dressings to grocery retailers through its proprietary Fresh35° continuous cold-chain platform. The Company provides retailers with a turnkey alternative to pasteurized beverages and in-store juicing, offering Ultra Fresh, clean-label products with exceptional taste and quality. Its growing portfolio also includes refrigerated dressings.
